text: I think you'll enjoy this recipe, Now This is Alice Springs Chicken, given your past preference for boneless skinless chicken breast halves and chicken-breasts. The combination of balsamic vinegar, which you've liked in other recipes, and the use of chicken, tomatoes, and mushrooms, ingredients you've shown a fondness for, make this dish a good fit for your tastes. The cooking time is a bit longer than your typical liked recipe, but the ingredients and flavors involved might make it worth the extra effort.
